soon_2026_11_12:
The Skate Lending Library van will visit ice rink locations starting November 20, 2026.

Dates and times are subject to change based on rink availability.

The 2026/2027 schedule is coming soon.

How to Participate

The Skate Lending Library is free for all ages and requires no prior reservation. Check the schedule on this page, look out for a Skate Lending Library van and get laced up!

Equipment includes:

  • Skates
  • Helmets
  • Skating aids

    • Date modified: September 25, 2026
